import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    S = next(it)
    T = next(it)
    P = next(it)

    height = [0] * (S + 1)
    for i in range(1, S + 1):
        height[i] = next(it)

    adj = [[] for _ in range(S + 1)]
    for _ in range(T):
        i = next(it)
        j = next(it)
        adj[i].append(j)
        adj[j].append(i)

    memo = [-1] * (S + 1)

    def dfs(u):
        if memo[u] != -1:
            return memo[u]

        best = 0
        for v in adj[u]:
            if height[u] > height[v]:
                best = max(best, 1 + dfs(v))

        memo[u] = best
        return best

    print(dfs(P))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
